1. Anne is young. (Given)  
2. If something is young then it is rough. (Rule 2) → Anne is rough.  
3. Rough things are big. (Rule 8) → Anne is big.  
4. All young, big things are red. (Rule 7) → Anne is red.  
5. If something is red then it is round. (Rule 3) → Anne is round.  
6. If something is red and round then it is not furry. (Rule 9) → Anne is not furry.  

Thus the statement “Anne is not furry” follows from the facts and rules.

ANSWER: True
